not_met.lacks: The evaluator's developer writes Answers, and the developers of the planner and tree.py read them. The planner makes each intent good from them, and tree.py cuts each shortfall beside the intent it falls short of, as dev/rn/architecture.md:150, dev/rn/architecture.md:400, and dev/rn/architecture.md:412 say. Yet in dev/rn/images/data-model.svg, Answers joins only Round and Deliverable, and no line joins it to Intent.
